high_level_description: This image captures a serene evening scene with a beautiful sunset sky as the focal point. The sky is a gradient of colors, transitioning from deep blue at the top to soft pinks and oranges near the horizon, indicating that the sun has recently set. There are a few scattered clouds, adding texture to the sky. In the foreground, there are two prominent buildings. On the left, there is a white building with a classical architectural style, featuring columns and a balcony.
